title: Acyclic base case for normalized external cup
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X,Y$ quasi-compact $k$-schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, and $F,G$ quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Use the scalar resolution models [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model] and normalization [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]. Write $H^p$ for module right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. If $H^p(X,F)=H^p(Y,G)=0$ for all $p>0$, then for every normalized cochain realization $c$, $H^n(c)$ is an isomorphism for every $n\in\mathbb N$.

source.place: Varieties Tag 0BED proof after equation 33.29.1.1: exact coefficient sequences, two dimension-shifting inductions and acyclic Leray base case

proof.text: Apply natural-degree tensor Kunneth to the constructed nonnegative scalar models. In positive degree each natural p+q=n summand has a positive factor, hence is zero by hF or hG and the model comparison. Direct-sum induction makes source homology zero. The acyclic external-coefficients theorem makes target homology zero; every map between these zero vector spaces is bijective.

In degree zero prove the natural index set has only (0,0). Its direct-sum inclusion is bijective by evaluation for injectivity and direct-sum induction for surjectivity. Compose this inclusion with tensor Kunneth to identify source homology with the tensor of the two degree-zero factor homologies.

Obtain the degree-zero geometric tensor equivalence, transport the two factors and target through picardScalarModelEquiv, and compare the resulting linear equivalence with H(c). Lift arbitrary factor homology elements through the surjective homology projections. Tensor Kunneth provides a tensor cycle, and hc identifies H(c) on its class with externalCup. The geometric pure-tensor formula proves equality; tensor extensionality extends it to all tensors. Transport injectivity and surjectivity through the source equivalence to prove IsIso H(c).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, equation-kunneth-on-cech and acyclic Leray base case; final degree-zero cup verification; C1 separated geometric vanishing and degree-zero section tensor comparison, and proved the normalized homology-map reduction in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem picardExternalCupCochain_isIso_of_acyclic
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F))
    (hG : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj G))
    (c : picardExternalTotal f g F G ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hc : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F G c) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c (n : ℤ))
